summary: Verified 3 changes end-to-end: (1) parent participation (task creation w/ parent assignee chip, complete via short-mytasks → +25 pts flash, points went 320→345, myrewards shows 6 rewards), (2) leaderboard now returns all family members incl. parent (Papa visible in 'Top de la semaine'; parent appears after earning points; API ordering desc by points verified), (3) multi-day event range shows dots on every day 22/23/24/25 in August 2026 grid (24 has 2 dots due to overlapping seed event). Kid shortcuts (kid-shortcut-calendar / kid-shortcut-shopping) present on Kid Home; child created event and shopping item successfully. Backend 7/7 pytest passed. All critical flows work.

shared/mytasks.tsx filter (t.assigned_to?.length === 0) || includes(user.id) correctly shows unassigned + parent-assigned tasks; parent role uses same completion endpoint (photo optional/required).
seed_data_creation: Test data: TEST_UI_ParentTask (deleted via test), TEST_KidTrip (kept), TEST_KidBonbons shopping item (kept); backend fixtures TEST_* auto-cleaned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DateTimeField on web is itself a TextInput — use [data-testid="event-start-field"] directly (do NOT use ' input' suffix). PIN keypad uses [data-testid="pin-key-{d}"] (not pin-digit). Multi-day dots verified by counting DOM elements with computed width/height of 5px inside each [data-testid="day-YYYY-MM-DD"] cell.
